title: [TARGETED] Special Gift Cards: Get 3000 CBA Pts (plus 2pts per $1) for > $150 Spend @ CommBank Yello (Activation Required)
body:
Deal: [TARGETED] Special Gift Cards: Get 3000 CBA Pts (plus 2pts per $1) for > $150 Spend @ CommBank Yello (Activation Required)

[7bobas] I got 2,000 points for a $100 or more spend.
[payton] I see, for both offers the cashback is 8.8% returned as CBA points.
[bdl] Damn Commbank really screwed up Yello with this points crap.
I got 2000pt/$100 - but looks like can't spend the points until I hit a minimum of 2500 pt for gift cards, right?
[payton] Yes, minimum is 2500 pts for a $10 card.
I hate the new system too, previous one had much better rates. The 10% / $5 cashback at Coles were offered so frequently.
[ironworthy] yep. i don't know why they changed the system. the points scheme sux
[littlesoldier] Ever since Yello switched to points, there's zero incentive to bother.
The return is worse than the old cashback, and you're forced to hoard points just to cash out for gift cards you can already buy at a discount elsewhere.
[TEER3X] Yes, I'm not going to even bother with the conversions because I'm simply not going to use them anymore.
Also, it's pretty obvious that changes like this always make it worse value for the consumer.
[payton] For today only (9 Nov), Amazon gift cards at the CBA Yello portal are offered at 5% off (soo generous /s)
2,375 2500 points for $10 Amazon GC.
[Gemka2K18] How could this point system get approved in the first place it's friggin' terrible.
[OnlyHans] Supermarket Slayer is still available via https://special.gift/shop/supermarket-slayer/
